claim.quote: From the electron spectra we obtain $\lambda = g_A/g_V = -1.27641(45)_\mathrm{stat}(33)_\mathrm{sys}$ which confirms recent measurements with improved precision.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the journal version is Phys. Rev. Lett. 122, 242501 (2019).

name: Measurement of the Weak Axial-Vector Coupling Constant in the Decay of Free Neutrons Using a Pulsed Cold Neutron Beam

summary.plain: PERKEO III used a pulsed beam of cold neutrons for the first time to measure the weak axial-vector coupling constant. The value, lambda = -1.27641 with an uncertainty of about 0.0006, confirms recent measurements with better precision.
summary.technical: Beta asymmetry of polarized free neutrons with a pulsed cold neutron beam suppressing leading systematics: lambda = g_A/g_V = -1.27641(45) stat (33) sys, corresponding to A_0 = -0.11985(17) stat (12) sys; implications for V_ud and a limit on a left-handed tensor interaction.

title: Measurement of the Weak Axial-Vector Coupling Constant in the Decay of Free Neutrons Using a Pulsed Cold Neutron Beam
why_it_matters: The abstract says the pulsed beam method suppresses the leading sources of systematic uncertainty.
